heroHeadline: Day 4,831: BTS Tops September Brand Reputation Rankings Ahead of SoFi Stadium Finale
heroSubtitle: September 4, 2026 is Day 4,831 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The Korean Business Research Institute's September Advertising Model Brand Reputation Rankings (released Sept 3, data gathered Aug 3-Sept 3) placed BTS first overall, ahead of rookie group RESCENE and trot star Lim Young-woong. The result landed during a rest day in the ARIRANG World Tour's Los Angeles stand, between the SoFi Stadium run's first two sold-out shows (Sept 1-2, where Jungkook celebrated his 29th birthday onstage) and its closing two dates (Sept 5-6).
